blocks.text: ROME, Italy—Pope Leo‘s doctors said Thursday a chest X-ray showed “good recovery of the operated lung,” two days after the pontiff underwent surgery to remove a cancerous tumor. “This morning, the Holy Father underwent routine check-ups, which yielded normal results,” said his doctors Luigi Carbone and Stefano Margaritora. They added, in the note published by the Vatican, that Pope Leo‘s recovery was “progressing as expected.” /apl... Keep on reading: Pope Leo's doctors say chest X-ray shows 'good recovery' of lung
